ITEM.PTXT: If a drive plan is created on the G-BOOK.com or GAZOO.com site from a PC or mobile phone, waypoints and destinations can be set simply by downloading it to the on-board unit. In addition, in cooperation with the map information service, spots searched for using a personal computer or cellular phone can be registered as G-memory points and set as destinations.
Touching "Drive Plan" on the G-BOOK screen and selecting the desired drive plan downloads the drive plan and starts the route search.
For details, check the G-BOOK site (http://g-book.com/).
When using G-BOOK mX without Web registration, GAZOO membership registration is required.
